name: Campingplatz Alpenwelt Tannheimer Tal
beschreibung: The campsite Campingplatz Alpenwelt is located on the edge of Tannheim in the valley of the same name at an altitude of around 1,100 metres. The site offers direct access to the Tannheimer See and is surrounded by gentle alpine meadows and mountain ranges. Guests will find pitches for motorhomes and tents, sanitary facilities and a small shop. The area is suitable for hiking and cycling in summer as well as for winter walks in the cold season.
